messages.author: ebbcca4e0e1623c5
messages.subject: FragPipe-DIA-NN-MSstats question about annotation file
parts:
Dear MSstats team, 

 I'm working on trying to set up a DIA data processing pipeline for our lab using the FragPipe-DIA-NN combo and then MSstats. I was excited to see the DIANNtoMSstatsFormat function, which worked well for me, except for some trouble with the annotation file. When I take the experiment_annotation.tsv file directly from the DIA-NN output and use it without modification, I get the following message:
Error in .checkAnnotation(input, annotation) : ** Columns Condition, BioReplicate missing in the annotation. Please check the annotation file.

If I modify the annotation file to the structure recommended with the Run, Condition, and BioReplicate labels, the data is processed successfully and appears to be in the correct format for MSstats. However, when I try to run additional MSstats scripts (e.g. dataProcess on the MSstats formatted data, I encounter the following error.

Error in MSstatsMergeFractions(input) :
*** error : can't figure out which multiple runs come from the same sample.

Is there a way to restructure the annotation file to avoid this error and/or any other options to help with the data formatting so that it will be usable for MSstats? The fragpipe outputted annotation file and reformatted annotation file are attached and the DIA-NN output is here, as it is too large to attach.

Thank you for the help and apologies if this is a newbie-overly obvious question.

Keri

Keri

messages.author: ebbcca4e0e1623c5
messages.subject: Re: FragPipe-DIA-NN-MSstats question about annotation file
parts:
Hi All,

Thanks to a lot of help from Alison Chaves, we came up with this workaround. I was unable to fix the original error by simply modifying the annotation file and instead also had to modify the DIA-NN output. It seems like this is caused by some syntax changes in the column headings of the DIANN output obtained from FragPipe. For reference, I'm running dplyr_1.1.3 diann_1.0.1 MSstats_4.10.0 BiocManager_1.30.22 MSstatsConvert_1.11.5.

diann_report <- diann_load("diann-output.tsv") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Run = sub("2022-02-09-KB-SY79-", "", Run)) %>%
    group_by(Stripped.Sequence,
              Modified.Sequence,
              Q.Value,
              Lib.Q.Value,
              Lib.PG.Q.Value,
               Protein.Group,
               Precursor.Charge,
               Fragment.Quant.Raw,
               Run,
               Genes.MaxLFQ) %>%
      summarize() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Condition = str_extract(Run, "dilution|DIA"),
                BioReplicate = str_extract(Run, "DMSO|DMSO|DMSO"),
                FragmentIon = NA,
                ProductCharge = NA,
                IsotopeLabelType = "L") %>%
         rename(StrippedSequence = Stripped.Sequence,
                ModifiedSequence = Modified.Sequence,
                ProteinNames = Protein.Group,
                QValue = Q.Value,
                LibQValue = Lib.Q.Value,
                LibPGQValue = Lib.PG.Q.Value,
                FragmentQuantCorrected = Fragment.Quant.Raw,
                PrecursorCharge = Precursor.Charge,
                Intensity = Genes.MaxLFQ)

annotation_file2 <- diann_report %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::select(Run, BioReplicate, Condition) %>%
    distinct()
    ```
This seems to work as a temporary workaround, but i wanted to share with you all in case others encounter this issue.

Best,

Keri
